## CETRI AI Assistant

A Python-based AI assistant inspired by Jarvis from Iron Man with voice input/output, automation tools, and a GUI dashboard.

### Quick Start

1. Run: python main.py or use the VS Code task (Ctrl+Shift+B)
2. Click "Start Listening" to interact with CETRI
3. Speak your command

### Features

- Voice input via Whisper (STT)
- Text-to-speech output via pyttsx3
- GUI dashboard with tkinter
- File and OS automation
- Intelligent command processing

### Project Setup Completed

All dependencies installed. See README.md for full documentation.
